families.title: Incretins and glucagon
families.blurb: Every modern obesity drug in this family is a rewrite of the same 30-residue scaffold. Tirzepatide and retatrutide borrow their N-terminus from GIP and their tail from exenatide; Aib residues block the DPP-4 enzyme that cuts native GLP-1 in minutes.

families.title: Amylin analogues
families.blurb: Human amylin clumps into amyloid fibrils. Pramlintide copies the three prolines of rat amylin, which cannot aggregate. Cagrilintide and eloralintide add further substitutions and a fatty acid for once-weekly dosing; eloralintide also carries three non-natural residues and a thioacetal in place of the disulfide, and favours amylin receptors over the calcitonin receptor.

families.title: Melanocortins
families.blurb: All melanocortin drugs keep α-MSH's His-Phe-Arg-Trp message sequence. Swapping in D-phenylalanine and norleucine made afamelanotide potent and stable; cyclising the core produced melanotan II, bremelanotide and setmelanotide. KPV is α-MSH's last three residues.

families.title: Growth-hormone-releasing hormone
families.blurb: The first 29 residues of GHRH carry its full activity. Sermorelin is exactly that fragment; CJC-1295 stabilises it with four substitutions and an albumin-binding lysine; tesamorelin keeps all 44 residues behind a fatty N-terminal cap.

families.title: Growth-hormone secretagogues
families.blurb: Small synthetic ghrelin-receptor agonists built around D-amino acids and a C-terminal D-Phe-Lys-NH₂. Ipamorelin trimmed GHRP-6 down to five residues for a cleaner growth-hormone pulse.

families.title: Oxytocin and vasopressin
families.blurb: Two nonapeptides from the posterior pituitary that differ at only two positions, yet one contracts the uterus and the other holds on to water. Desmopressin removes the N-terminal amine and flips arginine 8 to the D-form, abolishing the pressor effect.

families.title: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone
families.blurb: A D-amino acid at position 6 and an ethylamide in place of Gly10 turned the short-lived hypothalamic hormone into leuprolide, a long-acting agonist that shuts the pituitary down when given continuously.

families.title: Somatostatin
families.blurb: Octreotide keeps somatostatin's Phe-Trp-Lys-Thr turn inside a smaller disulfide ring, with D-Trp to resist enzymes: a 2-minute hormone became a drug that lasts hours.

families.title: Parathyroid hormone family
families.blurb: The first 34 residues of parathyroid hormone reproduce its bone-building signal. Abaloparatide is instead modelled on the related PTH-related protein.
